prompt: What is the iOS Customer app bundle ID?
response: com.dollorai.customer. Display name: 'Dollor'. Full bundle name: 'Dollor - $1 Delivery'. Team ID: PRKZ4UVCD7. Build number: 1077 (v1.0). Min iOS: 17.0. Source: project.pbxproj, Info.plist:10.

prompt: How does the iOS customer login endpoint work?
response: POST /api/auth/customer/login with Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Body: 'username={email}&password={password}'. Returns P2PCustomerLoginResponse with accessToken, tokenType, customerId, email, fullName, phone. Token stored in Keychain via SecureStorage + UserDefaults fallback. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1515-1572.

prompt: How does iOS customer Google sign-in work?
response: POST /api/auth/customer/google with JSON body: {email, name, google_id}. Returns P2PCustomerLoginResponse. Token stored in Keychain + UserDefaults. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1576-1638.

prompt: How does iOS customer Apple sign-in work?
response: POST /api/customer/apple-auth with JSON body: {email, name, apple_id, identity_token (optional)}. Returns P2PCustomerLoginResponse. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:1642-1709.

prompt: How does iOS customer registration work?
response: POST /api/auth/customer/register with JSON body: {email, password, full_name, phone (optional)}. IMPORTANT: Customer uses full_name (single field), NOT first_name/last_name. Returns P2PCustomerLoginResponse. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:2101-2176.

prompt: Where are iOS customer auth tokens stored?
response: In Keychain via SecureStorage.shared.customerAccessToken (P2PAPIService.swift:44-46). Also backed up to UserDefaults keys: p2p_customer_id, p2p_customer_email, p2p_customer_name. Migration from UserDefaults to Keychain happens on init (line 60). Vendor and driver tokens stored separately in Keychain.

prompt: What iOS customer address endpoints exist?
response: 6 endpoints: GET /api/customers/addresses (fetch all, P2PAPIService.swift:2188), GET /api/customers/addresses/default (default address, 2232), POST /api/customers/addresses (create, 2279), PUT /api/customers/addresses/{id} (update, 2394), DELETE /api/customers/addresses/{id} (delete, 2463), POST /api/customers/addresses/{id}/set-default (set default, 2504). All require customer JWT. Body fields: location_name, street, unit, city, state, zip_code, instructions, latitude, longitude, phone_number, is_default.

prompt: What is the P2PCustomerAddress model in iOS?
response: P2PCustomerAddress (P2PAPIService.swift:9098): id (String?), userId (String), locationName (String), street (String), unit (String), city (String), state (String), zipCode (String), instructions (String), addressType (String: Home/Work/Other), latitude (Double), longitude (Double), phoneNumber (String), isDefault (Bool). Uses snake_case JSON keys. Custom decoder handles both 'location_name' and 'label' keys. Source: Address.swift:60-103.

prompt: How does iOS customer fetch restaurants?
response: GET /api/vendors/published with query params: platform=ios, city (optional), cuisine (optional). Returns [P2PRestaurant] array. Only shows approved & published restaurants. P2PRestaurant fields: id, name, rating, deliveryTime, isApproved, isPublished, imageUrl, address, latitude, longitude, phone, cuisine, activePromotion. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:67-154.

prompt: How does iOS customer create an order?
response: POST /api/erp/orders/create with JSON body: vendor_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone, delivery_address (dict), delivery_instructions, items (array), tip, scheduled_for (optional ISO8601), promo_code (optional). Returns P2PCreateOrderResponse with client_secret for Stripe payment. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:2888-2970.

prompt: What iOS customer order endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/erp/orders/customer/{id} (order history, P2PAPIService.swift:2743), GET /api/erp/orders/customer/{id}/active (active orders, 2839), GET /api/erp/orders/{id}/track (tracking, 2798), POST /api/erp/orders/{id}/cancel (cancel with reason, 10923), GET /api/erp/orders/{id}/modification (partial order info, 11039), POST /api/erp/orders/{id}/respond-modification (accept/reject partial, 11091), GET /api/erp/orders/{id}/refund-status (refund info, 10986). All require customer JWT.

prompt: What order statuses does the iOS customer app use?
response: OrderStatus enum in Order.swift: pendingPayment, confirmed, pendingRestaurant, declinedByRestaurant, restaurantTimeout, preparing, readyForPickup, pendingDeliveryDecision, restaurantWillDeliver, deliveryDecisionTimeout, outForDelivery, delivered, cancelled, pendingModification. Raw values use snake_case (e.g., 'pending_payment'). Active: confirmed through outForDelivery. Terminal: delivered, cancelled, declined.

prompt: How does iOS customer rideshare request work?
response: POST /api/ride-requests/request with JSON body: {pickup_latitude, pickup_longitude, dropoff_latitude, dropoff_longitude}. Requires customer JWT. Returns RideRequestResponse with id, status, estimatedFare, estimatedDuration, estimatedDistance, platformFee. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:4967-5036.

prompt: How does iOS customer view and accept bids?
response: View bids: GET /api/ride-requests/{id}/bids returns [RideSuggestedBid] with driverId, driverName, driverRating, bidAmount, estimatedTime, vehicleType, distance (P2PAPIService.swift:5195-5243). Accept: POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/accept-bid with body {driver_id} (5329-5389). Counter: POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/counter-bid with body {driver_id, counter_amount} (5429-5488). All require customer JWT.

prompt: How does iOS customer payment for rides work?
response: Create intent: POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/create-payment-intent with body {amount}. Returns StripePaymentIntentResponse with client_secret (P2PAPIService.swift:5984-6033). Confirm: POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/confirm-payment with body {payment_intent_id}. Returns RidePaymentConfirmation (6035-6095). Both require customer JWT.

prompt: What iOS customer card management endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/payment/cards (fetch saved cards, P2PAPIService.swift:6097), POST /api/payment/cards with body {payment_method_id, is_default} (save card, 6137), DELETE /api/payment/cards/{id} (delete, 6208), POST /api/payment/cards/{id}/set-default (set default, 6242). StripeCard model: id, brand, last4, expMonth, expYear, isDefault, createdAt. All require customer JWT.

prompt: How does iOS customer tip a rideshare driver?
response: POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/tip. Sends tip_amount in BOTH JSON body AND query param for backend compatibility. Body: {tip_amount: Double}. Query: ?tip_amount=X. Max $500. Requires customer JWT. Returns P2PRatingSummary. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:10745-10808.

prompt: How does iOS customer rate a rideshare driver?
response: POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/rate with JSON body: {rating: Int (1-5), comment: String (optional)}. Requires customer JWT. Returns P2PRatingSummary. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:10679-10743.

prompt: How does iOS customer rate a delivery driver?
response: POST /api/erp/orders/{orderId}/rate-driver with JSON body: {driver_id, rating (1-5), comment (optional)}. Requires customer JWT. Returns P2PRatingSummary. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:10473-10541. Separate from ride rating endpoint.

prompt: How does iOS customer rate a restaurant?
response: POST /api/erp/orders/{orderId}/rate-restaurant with JSON body: {restaurant_id, rating (1-5), comment (optional)}. Requires customer JWT. Returns P2PRatingSummary. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:10541-10611.

prompt: What iOS customer favorite endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/customers/favorites (fetch all, P2PAPIService.swift:2557), POST /api/customers/favorites with body {restaurant_id} (add, 2599), DELETE /api/customers/favorites/{restaurantId} (remove, 2655), GET /api/customers/favorites/{restaurantId}/check (check if favorite, 2698). P2PFavorite: id, customerId, restaurantId, restaurantName, restaurantImageUrl, addedAt. All require customer JWT.

prompt: What iOS customer cart endpoints exist?
response: GET /api/cart (get cart, P2PAPIService.swift:11493), POST /api/cart/add with body {restaurant_id, item_id, quantity, customizations} (add item, 11547), PUT /api/cart/item/{id} with body {quantity, customizations} (update, 11614), DELETE /api/cart/item/{id} (remove, 11679), POST /api/cart/clear (clear cart, 11730). All require customer JWT. Returns P2PCartResponse.

prompt: What iOS customer chat endpoints exist?
response: For orders: POST /api/chat/order/{orderId}/message with body {message} (send, P2PAPIService.swift:10810), GET /api/chat/order/{orderId}/messages (fetch, 10868). For rides: GET /api/ride-requests/{id}/chat (fetch, 6445), POST /api/ride-requests/{id}/chat with body {message} (send, 6488). All require JWT auth.

prompt: What permissions does the iOS customer app request?
response: Camera (scan cards, profile photos), Location Always + When In Use (nearby restaurants, rides, delivery tracking), Microphone (voice search), Photo Library (profile photos), Contacts (delivery address sharing), Speech Recognition (voice ordering). Background modes: remote-notification only. Source: Info.plist:56-71.

prompt: How does iOS customer password reset work?
response: Request: POST /api/auth/customer/forgot-password with body {email}. Returns P2PErrorResponse (P2PAPIService.swift:1755-1807). Confirm: POST /api/auth/customer/reset-password with body {email, token, new_password}. Returns bool success (1809-1869). Token is sent via email, not returned in API response.

prompt: What is the iOS customer promo code flow?
response: Validate: POST /api/erp/promotions/validate with body {promo_code}. Returns P2PPromotion with discount details. Source: P2PAPIService.swift:3014-3075. Promo types: percentage, flat_amount, bogo, free_delivery, free_item, bundle. Known codes: FREEDELIVERY ($20 min, $5 max discount). Applied at checkout in createOrder call via promo_code parameter.
